title: a role-bounded type parameter accepts a role reference that narrows to the bound
purpose: With T = Counted and bound Named, the body calls the bound's action and callers get T back with its own role contract.

provenance.expected_basis: spec 6.5 role bounds; spec 12.1: generic inference from a role reference uses the role type, and a role reference crosses another role boundary when it already exposes every target action.
